items.summary: Recommendation: create no new SEO proposals, change requests, research requests, or work items this cycle. Existing evidence supports continuing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution, security evidence, and ownership-gap work. SEO intelligence records 98 actions across 39 sites, with 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions; site-level opportunities remain bounded by active work, failed requests, and measurement windows. Keep existing SEO opportunities deferred until ownership, validation, rollback, security, attribution, and measurement gates clear. Do not claim revenue or causal lift; the available Amazon result is $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable. Preserve the existing eastcoastrappers.com task-routing repair as the only bounded implementation path currently identified by the authoritative candidate list.

Maintain the existing SEO backlog and do not duplicate active work. Highest-priority recorded opportunities include xxxtea.com query cannibalization across five pages, saveusfarms.com CTR improvement for a land-preservation article, and page opportunities on stinkyleftfoot.com, marineactivity.com, greatamericanlakes.com, and deeppenetrations.com. These remain deferred where the snapshot records active work, measurement, failed-request repair, or ownership gates. Reconsider one bounded implementation after the relevant site clears those gates; acceptance must include the target URL, pre-change baseline, single primary metric, existing-telemetry measurement window, deterministic validation, and file-level rollback.
